skill.name: youtube-video-api-skill
skill.description: Extract structured YouTube channel and video metrics through the BrowserAct workflow API. The skill runs a Python helper that starts a BrowserAct task, polls completion, and prints channel and video details.
skill.summary: Collect YouTube channel video data with BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill is a BrowserAct API wrapper, not clear malware. Confirmed risks include external API calls, API key handling, one documented Python script invocation, and evasion-oriented marketing claims.

remediation.issue: Users may be asked to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY in chat.
remediation.suggestion: Remove guidance that asks users to provide the key to the agent. Require environment variables or a managed secret store instead.

remediation.issue: The helper sends credentials and channel URLs to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact endpoint, transmitted fields, and retention expectations before the skill runs.

remediation.issue: The documentation promotes avoiding CAPTCHA and geo-blocking.
remediation.suggestion: Remove evasion claims and add guidance to follow YouTube, BrowserAct, and local legal requirements.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to execute a local Python script.
remediation.suggestion: Validate channel URLs and video_type values before execution, and avoid shell interpolation when passing arguments.

content.value_statement: Manual YouTube channel research is slow and inconsistent. This skill uses BrowserAct to collect channel data and video metrics in structured output.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Python helper with a YouTube channel URL and video ordering mode.
Starts BrowserAct workflow template 82163578680973165 through the BrowserAct API.
Supports Latest, Popular, and Earliest video ordering modes.
Polls task status for up to 300 seconds with timestamped progress logs.
Prints channel fields and video metrics returned by the BrowserAct task.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key in BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Processes one YouTube channel URL per script run.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow output and does not verify data independently.

use_cases.title: Track competitor channel performance
use_cases.description: Collect popular or latest videos from a competitor channel for regular content strategy reviews.

use_cases.title: Prepare creator reporting
use_cases.description: Gather video titles, dates, views, comments, likes, and durations for creator performance summaries.

use_cases.title: Compare industry video trends
use_cases.description: Run channel checks across a research list and compare posting cadence or engagement signals.

prompt_templates.title: Get popular videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to extract Popular videos from this YouTube channel: <channel URL>. Summarize views, likes, comments, and publish dates.

prompt_templates.title: Review latest uploads
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill with Latest mode for <channel URL>. Return the newest videos and highlight posting cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Study channel history
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill with Earliest mode for <channel URL>. Summarize the first videos and note early content patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Compare several channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Run this skill for each listed channel, one channel at a time. Compare video counts, engagement signals, and strongest topics.

output_examples.input: Popular videos for a software product channel
output: Channel summary with title, channel URL, and subscriber count.
Video list with titles, URLs, publish dates, views, durations, comments, and likes.
Short notes on the videos with the strongest engagement.

output_examples.input: Latest uploads for a competitor channel
output: Recent video list ordered by upload recency.
Posting cadence summary based on returned publish dates.
Metrics snapshot for views, comments, likes, and duration.

output_examples.input: Earliest videos for a creator channel
output: Initial video titles and publish dates.
Brief summary of the creator origin pattern.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an environment variable before running the skill.
Use exact public YouTube channel URLs to reduce task errors.
Review platform policies before automating data collection.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into shared chats or logs.
Do not run repeated collection against channels without a compliance review.
Do not treat returned metrics as independently verified official data.

faq.question: What data can this skill return?
faq.answer: It can return channel title, channel URL, subscribers, video URLs, titles, dates, views, durations, comments, and likes.

faq.question: Does it require a BrowserAct account?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper requires a valid BrowserAct API key in the BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Which video ordering modes are supported?
faq.answer: The script supports Latest, Popular, and Earliest ordering modes.

faq.question: How long can a run take?
faq.answer: The script may run for several minutes and polls task status for up to 300 seconds.

faq.question: Does it scrape YouTube directly from my machine?
faq.answer: No. The helper sends a workflow request to BrowserAct and reads the task output.

faq.question: Can it process many channels at once?
faq.answer: No. The helper accepts one channel URL per script run.
